briefing.geography: An open-water beacon course bends north toward the fast storm-front water before returning to the finish.
goals: Cross the north-bending beacon course.
Build from the Claim-Boat deck while watching the western water.
rules: Five beacon gates mark the out-and-back course.
The Claim-Boat deck is the only surveyed build ground.
Waves enter from the west.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.reason: no boat-build or reanchor verb exists on the agent tool surface

pilots.headless: the rider pilots the run's only hero
pilots.roomSeat: a headless roster seat pilots its own hero
pilots.soloBrowser: a human pilots the hero; MOVE_HERO refuses HERO_NOT_YOURS

data.helmedWhile: aboard; a MOVE_HERO to navigable water sails the hull, and the hero rides the deck anchor
data.embark: walk the hero onto the deck: boarding is a CROSSING of the rail, so a hero that boots on the deck has not boarded
data.disembark: a move intent toward standable ground off the deck and within gangwayReach of the deck anchor, so a bow-ward intent steps nowhere and the hull runs aground on its clamp instead; after the start beacon this forfeits

data.racer: the Claim-Boat with a body aboard; a swimming hero and a moored hull score nothing
